scenes.say: Ever wonder why we bother scaling features? Does it really make a difference for your models?

scenes.label: Features
scenes.sub: Turn raw data into useful variables.
scenes.say: Feature engineering means turning raw data into variables your model can actually use.
First, your features might be all over the place. Standardization brings them to zero mean and unit variance, so every feature gets a fair shot.
Models like support vector machines, nearest neighbors, and neural nets need scaling. Tree-based models? Not so much.

scenes.question: Should you fit scaler on all data?
scenes.right: No, fit only on training data to prevent leakage.
scenes.say: Here's a classic trap: never fit your scaler on the whole dataset. Fit it only on training data, or you'll leak information and inflate your results.
